core_transactions.title: 業務核心與交易類 (Core Business & Transactions)
core_transactions.description: 包含問題題庫、專家落地方案、交易與點數流水、即時對話商議

identity_governance.title: 用戶身分與審核治理類 (Identity, Verification & Governance)
identity_governance.description: 包含用戶個人與帳號資料、專家審核申請庫、管理員操作與高權限稽核日誌

engagement_social.title: 互動通知與評價體系類 (Engagement, Notifications & Reviews)
engagement_social.description: 包含站內即時通知、用戶個人收藏題庫、專家評價評分紀錄

compliance_settings.title: 法律合規與平台設定類 (Compliance & Platform Settings)
compliance_settings.description: 包含法律條款同意簽署存證、會員方案費率定價、首頁看板公開指標設定

User.title: User
User.description: User profile with balance, points, role, KYC status, and bank account

Question.title: Question
Question.description: Problem or inquiry posted by a questioner

Answer.title: Answer
Answer.description: Solution proposal submitted by a solver

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Ledger record of points, payouts, recharges, and escrows

NotificationItem.title: NotificationItem
NotificationItem.description: In-app notification for events, messages, and AI matching

TermsAgreement.title: TermsAgreement
TermsAgreement.description: Legal consent and agreement record with timestamp and version

AuditLog.title: AuditLog
AuditLog.description: Security audit record for admin actions, grants, and blocks

PlatformSetting.title: PlatformSetting
PlatformSetting.description: Global settings for commissions, plans, and metrics

/questions/{questionId}.description: Stores questions and bounties posted on IdeaX

/answers/{answerId}.description: Stores solution proposals submitted for questions

/transactions/{txId}.description: Stores all financial, point transfer, and escrow records

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profiles, points, balances, and verification state

/certifications/{certId}.description: Stores expert certification and KYC applications

/audit_logs/{logId}.description: Stores admin governance, grant quota, and moderation logs

/notifications/{notifId}.description: Stores user in-app notifications and alerts

/solvers/{solverId}.description: Stores certified solvers, specialty tags, and reputation metrics

/terms_agreements/{agreementId}.description: Stores legal terms agreement timestamps and versions

/platform_settings/{settingId}.description: Stores system configurations, subscription plans, and admin grants
